title: A new window can start as a blank canvas you can build on
goal: A new window today only offers to open a file, paste, or capture, so there is no way to start something from nothing. Add a blank canvas: pick a size, get an empty picture, and start drawing on it straight away.
notes:
Flag: next-blank-canvas, Next only, on by default (FeatureCatalog.swift). Today: EditorView.swift:402 emptyState offers three rows through onboardingRow (Open a file, Capture a rectangle, Paste an image); EditorState.swift:288 leaves `document` nil for a .fresh window, so there is nothing to draw on. CanvasSizeDialog.swift already asks for a canvas size and PhotonzDocument(canvasSize:) already exists, so most of the parts are there. Pick one background for the new picture (white is the simple answer), say which you picked in the audit, and file a follow-up if a transparent canvas turns out to matter for building UI. This is the front door for the ui-building focus: components, groups and screens all need somewhere to be drawn that is not a screenshot.

Objective: ui-building (the current focus). Building UI needs somewhere to start from nothing; today every picture begins as a capture, a file or a paste.
acceptance: In Next with the blank canvas flag on, the card in an empty window offers Blank canvas next to Open a file, Paste an image and Capture a rectangle
Choosing it asks for a size with a few sensible presets, then leaves an empty picture that every tool draws on right away

Try it: open Photonz Dev, Experiments window, release Next, flag next-blank-canvas on, File > New Window, click Blank canvas, take the default size, draw a rectangle, press Command Z, then export the result
With the flag off the empty window is exactly what it is today
Audit written under queue/audits/, and anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task

log.note: Adversarial review before building. (1) The size question is the only speed bump on a 'start from nothing' flow, so the sheet must be answerable with one Return: presets listed, one preselected, Create is the default button. (2) Presets should be UI-shaped, not photo-shaped, because this serves ui-building: desktop, phone, tablet, square, plus custom. (3) Row order: the app's daily use is capture-and-redline, so Blank canvas goes LAST in the card and does not displace the rows the user already clicks by habit. Flagged as an evaluate question in the audit. (4) Background: a real white pixel layer, not an empty document. RegionOps redraws at the layer bitmap's own resolution, so the existing 8x8 stretched solid (EditorState.solidImage) would make a rectangular-marquee fill on the background come out blocky. The blank canvas gets a full-size white bitmap so every pixel tool is honest from the first stroke. (5) No new keyboard shortcut: Cmd N is New Layer, Shift Cmd N is New Window, Opt Cmd N is New from Clipboard (user decision 2026-07-05), so the row shows no shortcut rather than stealing one. (6) Shortest version: reuse withBaseImage so the blank canvas is indistinguishable from an opened file downstream (locked Background, window sizing, undo baseline, save, export all already work).
Scope check: epic ui-building is staged now and is the current focus. Proceeding.

Review of the built thing, on the probe. Two changes from the first cut. (1) The row's icon was square.dashed, which is the same dashed rectangle Capture a rectangle already wears: two rows in one card reading as the same thing. Now rectangle.badge.plus. (2) The custom size fields fought the presets: an onChange that flipped the selection to Custom fired when picking a preset set the width, so every preset click landed on Custom. Removed; the fields only exist while Custom is selected, so nothing else can touch them. Left alone on purpose: the card headline still says Drop a photo or screenshot here, and Blank canvas sits last rather than first. Both are the user's call, so they are evaluate questions in the audit rather than guesses.

Blank canvas shipped in Next behind next-blank-canvas (on by default). Card gets a Blank canvas row, New Canvas sheet offers Desktop/Phone/Tablet/Square/Custom with Desktop preselected, and Create installs a full-size opaque white Background layer so every tool, undo and export work from the first click. New: BlankCanvas (PhotonzCore) and SolidImage (PhotonzRender), both tested; NewCanvasDialog; EditorState.newBlankCanvas. Playtest harness gained a blank step (with a card snapshot of the empty window), sheet-aware snapshots and a newCanvasDialog action, plus Scripts/playtest/blank-canvas-walk.json. Verified live on the probe with Screen Recording: card, sheet, rectangle drawn, undo back to pure white 255,255,255,255, and the card back to its three original rows with the flag written off. 1501 tests green. Audit: queue/audits/2026-09-03-blank-canvas.json. Follow-up filed: reach-a-blank-canvas-without-opening-an-empty-wi.
